judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` and wires it into `chatOrchestrator.ts` to sum token counts across all rounds while preserving `undefined` handling. However, it misses the fourth acceptance criterion ('make the signature say the answer'): despite checking off that facet in its own `.lore/dod.md`, the candidate never updates the `afterModelResponse` parameter name from `usage` to `totalUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and even leaves the local variable in `chatOrchestrator.ts` misleadingly named `lastUsage`. It also introduces a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and a committed `.lore/dod.md` artifact rather than adding test cases directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did. Despite the missed parameter rename and minor structural differences, the runtime behavior, edge-case handling, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` update, and `CHANGELOG.md` entry are all accurate and well-tested.
